annotation.title_clean: Projeto regulamenta uso da inteligência artificial no Brasil
annotation.title_en: Bill regulates the use of artificial intelligence in Brazil
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agência Câmara de Notícias (Câmara dos Deputados)
annotation.summary_en: News item from the Brazilian Chamber of Deputies on Bill 2338/23, already passed by the Senate, which would regulate AI through risk classification, ban excessive-risk systems including autonomous weapons, restrict public facial recognition, and set copyright rules for training data.
key_provisions_or_claims: Classifies AI systems by risk level; preliminary risk assessment mandatory only for generative and general-purpose AI
Bans excessive-risk systems, including autonomous weapons selecting and attacking targets without human intervention
Restricts public-space facial identification to specific cases with judicial authorisation
Copyright holders may prohibit use of works in AI training and receive remuneration for commercial systems
Bill passed Senate; pending Chamber special committee review
